subject: 1600WP (January 2010) page 1 item 5, the fourth (branch-code) group of the PRIMARY withholding-agent TIN comb chain: the printed box x 218.52-276.00, y 139.20-156.72 pt (top-left origin) in the pinned source '1600WP p1ENCS.pdf' sha256 6ea2ef0f6c84a68ef1c50ad63f4ff0e95a68258f52b62b98f305c861c8b75d55. BIR's own field key for it is frm1600WP:txtBranchCode. The cell id p1c16 is a HINT only: cell ids are quantised bounding boxes and renumber on any geometry change, so the printed box is what identifies the subject and the edit anchor below is what binds it to a batch. This record's subject is the item-5 box and nothing else. The second, unrelated TIN comb further down the same page (emitted as p1c74, printed box 366.48-401.28 x 465.96-479.76, 309pt below item 5) is the subject of a SEPARATE record, C06, and is not touched here.
what: The branch-code comb carries five compartments instead of four, inside the SAME printed box. Nothing is widened, moved or repainted: the emitted box stays 57.47 x 17.53pt at 218.53,139.19, the writing surface stays top 0.75pt / height 16.03pt, and the five compartments divide the box equally -- left(i) = round(i * 57.47 / 5, 2) giving 0 / 11.49 / 22.99 / 34.48 / 45.98pt and widths 11.49 / 11.50 / 11.49 / 11.50 / 11.49pt, which sum to exactly 57.47pt. Each compartment carries one text input, class 'fi fh21 fc', maxlength 1, sharing the group's field name, slot indexes 0..4 contiguous. Declared pitch attribute 11.49 (nominal 57.47/5 = 11.494). The equal division absorbs the consumed batch's horizontal insets -- first slot left 0.37pt, last slot right 57.47-(41.74+15.35) = 0.38pt -- so the five compartments run edge to edge inside the emitted box; that is a deliberate, declared consequence of the division rule and not a change to the box, to the vertical writing surface, or to any artwork.
reason: BIR's January-2010 artwork for 1600WP is CORRECT and OUT OF DATE. Measured from the pinned PDF, the item-5 branch box prints exactly three internal ticks, at x 232.68, 247.68 and 260.28, each 3.00pt tall at the foot of the box and 0.75pt wide -- four compartments -- and, unlike 2550M, BIR pre-prints nothing inside them: 132,092 of the box's 133,172 interior pixels rasterise exactly white at 12x. BIR's own eBIRForms client, whose runtime this repository has harvested, declares that same field with max_length 5. No rule can derive 'BIR widened this field after 2010' from 2010 ink, which is exactly why this is a stage-2 correction and not a stage-1 producer bug. Filing safety: a branch code is what tells the Bureau WHICH establishment a withholding return belongs to. A filer whose branch code has five digits cannot enter it on today's form at all, so the return files against a truncated branch and the establishment that actually withheld the tax files nothing. Corpus context, measured from the pinned PDFs on 2026-08-08: of 53 bundles, 39 print 3+3+3+5, three print 3+3+3+3 (2550M, 2551M 2002, 2553 1999), one prints 3+3+3+4 -- this form -- and ten are not measurable by that method. 1600WP is the single 3+3+3+4 bundle in that census; the three 3+3+3+3 bundles each need their own record and 2550M already has one (C01).
authority: BIR eBIRForms HTA runtime declaration (harvested), regulation not identified in-repo. rules/forms/1600wp-v2010/fields.json declares field_key frm1600WP:txtBranchCode with constraints.max_length = 5, confidence "high", source_refs ["official-hta-runtime#control:L464", "official-hta-runtime#saveXML:L2580-L2660", "revision-matched-encrypted-sample"]; the same file declares frm1600WP:txtTIN1 / txtTIN2 / txtTIN3 with max_length 3 each (official-hta-runtime#control:L461 / L462 / L463), all four at item_number "5" on page 1, so the 3-3-3 part of the chain is agreed and only the branch code is not. That declaration covers the item-5 PRIMARY group only; this record makes no authority claim about any other TIN comb on the page. NO BIR issuance is cited because none could be identified from anything in this checkout; that gap is stated deliberately rather than filled with a plausible-looking regulation number, and it stays visible until someone supplies the real one.
diverges_from: audit.py comb_slots_match_printed on the 1600WP item-5 branch comb -- the corrected document emits five compartments where the pinned artwork prints four, and must keep being reported as an offender of that assertion (failure kind layout-printed-mismatch where the layout carries the change, invalid-emission where only the markup does). audit.py inputs_span_no_printed_divider must gain exactly three offenders on this comb: five 11.49/11.50pt compartments across a box whose printed dividers stand at x 232.68, 247.68 and 260.28 put each of those three dividers strictly inside a corrected input (slots 1, 2 and 3), where today all four inputs have their edges on the dividers and the assertion reports none. That re-opens finding F178, which was closed by making every one of those three dividers a compartment wall; F178 must be re-opened and re-reviewed against this override rather than left closed. comb_referee's EXPECTED_HTML_STRUCTURE_SHA256["1600wp-2010"] = ab1e006ade827451181a305fc064f95515dda96fcc4d07a50ee804eb3326e54c will not match a corrected document, because that pin moves with the emitted slot rectangles; it must NOT be re-pinned to accommodate this override. Neither assertion may be allowlisted, excluded or waived to make this correction quiet, no tolerance moves for it (DIVIDER_INTERIOR_PT 0.5, DIVIDER_MIN_Y_OVERLAP_PT 1.0, position 0.25pt stand), and EXPECTED_COMBS_BY_SLUG["1600wp-2010"] = 23 and EXPECTED_RETAINED_SUBJECTS_BY_SLUG["1600wp-2010"] = 2 must not move either, because they count comb SUBJECTS and this record changes one subject's slot count without adding or removing a subject.
verified_by: An independent producer, sharing nothing with whatever writes the correction: the four printed compartments are re-derived from the pinned PDF by a reader that is not extract.py (re-derived while authoring this record by `mutool draw -F trace`, by Poppler `pdftocairo -svg` and by a 12x grey raster of the box interior, all agreeing with PyMuPDF to 0.01pt on the box 218.52-276.00 / 139.20-156.72 and the three ticks 232.68 / 247.68 / 260.28), and the five emitted compartments are re-derived from the written bytes by a parser that reads none of emit.py's markers. Not from build/layout, not from the IR, not from the applier's own manifest, and not from a determinism re-run -- that runs the writer twice and both halves drift together.
notes: Evidence, with every coordinate and its re-derivation, lives beside this record at tools/formgen/corrections/evidence/C05-evidence.json (schema: tools/formgen/corrections/schema/correction-record.schema.json); the 53-bundle census it cites is tools/formgen/corrections/evidence/tin-branch-census-20260808.json. The `find` anchor is the item-5 branch comb exactly as forms/extra/1600wp-2010/index.html carries it at HEAD 98ca03c3 (1,190 bytes, occurring once in that document, which is clean against the commit); the `replace` is 1,421 bytes. It is deliberately batch-bound: if a later batch emits that comb differently the applier refuses rather than guessing, and the record is re-anchored and re-reviewed against that batch. The declared before/after counts were computed on 98ca03c3's bytes and must be re-derived by the applier from the bytes it actually writes. The second page-1 TIN comb, emitted as p1c74, is the subject of record C06 and is deliberately untouched here: the two edit spans do not overlap (p1c16 occupies bytes 143457-144646 of index.html, p1c74 starts at 169549), and a simulated application of this edit alone leaves the p1c74 element byte-identical. Both records change the same file, so they must ship in the SAME apply batch or the second one's anchor will be evaluated against a document the first one already rewrote; C05 and C06 are independent claims about different printed boxes and neither presumes the other's authority. Because they share a file, every effect declared here is scoped to strings that only this record's edit can move: no effect counts `data-comb-slots="4"` document-wide, and none mentions p1c74, since the applier re-derives counts from the bytes it finally writes and those would then be measuring C06's edit as well as this one.
